definition: II. [ פָּרָשׁ ] noun [masculine] horse, steed (less common synonym of סוּס ( > explained away by Schw ZAW viii (1888). 191 ); Arabic horse, mare (often), so Ethiopic : compare Sabean פרס horse , Mordtm Him. Inschr. 70 ); — Plural פָּרָשִׁים (erroneous for * פְּרָשִׁים Kö ii. 1, 89 ) Ezek 27:14 +, suffix פָּרָשָׁיו Isa 28:28 ; 1Sam 8:11 — steeds Ezek 27:14 ( + סוּסִים , פְּרָדִים ), from Togarmah; simile of swiftness Joel 2:4 (|| סוּסִים ); probably also Isa 28:28 ; Jer 46:4 (|| סוּסִים , compare Gf Gie ), and perhaps ׳ וְשָׂם לוֺ בְּמֶרְכַבְחוֺ וּבָעָרָשָׁיו וְרָצוּ וגו 1Sam 8:11 (king subject).
